rationale: Manjot's mobile app development expertise and NestJS hiring needs align well with Sid's full-stack engineering background in Python and JavaScript. intro_message: Manjot Singh, meet Sid Kurra — a San Francisco-based engineer who builds with Python and JavaScript and has experience with developer tools, which could be valuable as you expand your mobile and backend engineering capabilities at Ajath.
